links.outcome: Users' experience of dependency and absence of human escalation pathways in mental health chatbots
links.effect: Fragile Dependency theme: prolonged use generated attachment anxiety about app discontinuation or data breaches, compounded by absence of human escalation pathways. Authors call for mandatory human handoff protocols.
links.quote: prolonged use generated attachment anxiety about potential app discontinuation or data breaches, compounded by absence of human escalation pathways

unlisted_practices: Culturally adaptive design of mental health chatbots for local idioms of distress in LMIC contexts
Transparent communication of algorithmic boundaries to chatbot users

screen.reason: This is an empirical qualitative study investigating adults' real-world lived experiences, attachment, and safety concerns with generative AI mental health chatbots, highlighting deployment needs such as human escalation pathways.
